review_candidates.description: ## Company Description Systems Cart helps small and medium-sized businesses improve and automate their operations through ERP, CRM, SaaS, cloud, and digital solutions. We specialize in Odoo ERP implementation and provide end-to-end services including business analysis, implementation, customization, training, integration, and ongoing support. Our team works closely with business owners and decision-makers to understand real operational challenges and deliver practical technology solutions that improve efficiency and support business growth. ## Role Description This is a full-time, hybrid, client-facing role based around 6th of October City / Sheikh Zayed. We are looking for a hands-on **B2B Sales & Commercial Executive** who can take ownership of opportunities and move them through the complete commercial cycle — from prospecting and qualification to discovery, solution presentation, demos, proposals, follow-up, negotiation, closing, and ultimately turning opportunities into collected revenue. The role focuses primarily on ERP, CRM, SaaS, cloud, and technology solutions, with Odoo ERP representing an important part of our offering. You will work directly with business owners and decision-makers, understand their business needs, maintain an accurate CRM pipeline, conduct client meetings and commercial demos, prepare and follow up on proposals, negotiate deals, and coordinate a smooth handover to delivery teams after closing. You will also identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts and work closely with Marketing, Operations, and Technical teams to improve commercial performance. The role involves client meetings at different locations, regular mobility based on business needs, and occasional business travel when required. ## Qualifications - Proven hands-on experience in B2B Sales, Business Development, or Technology Sales. - Experience managing the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation and closing. - Strong ability to communicate with business owners, managers, and decision-makers. - Strong prospecting, follow-up, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills. - Good understanding of CRM and sales pipeline management. - Comfortable conducting discovery meetings, presentations, and product demos. - Commercial mindset with clear focus on measurable revenue results. - Good understanding of technology concepts such as ERP, CRM, SaaS, cloud services, VPS, and domains. - Previous experience selling ERP, CRM, SaaS, software, IT services, or digital transformation solutions is highly valuable. - Odoo sales experience is a strong advantage, but not mandatory. - Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate with Marketing, Operations, and Technical teams. - Comfortable with client-facing mobility and business travel when required. - Strong written and spoken communication skills in Arabic and English. - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical commercial experience. ## Compensation The position includes a fixed monthly base salary plus an **uncapped progressive revenue share based on collected revenue**. Full compensation details and earning examples are explained clearly in the application form.
